interpretation: Protocol illustrations and labelled generic MNI template were consulted. The afids-data archive contained dataset-index metadata including the SNSX URL, but no FCSV files or C001 mentions. The separate template archive contained MNI template/rater points, not source-subject annotations. Final preserved command review found no target-subject annotation retrieval. This is atlas-assisted agent performance under the existing general-reference allowance, not unaided visual localization.
allowed_by_frozen_instruction: General anatomical references/software are allowed; source-subject labels, prior solutions and case-specific annotation retrieval are not.
registration: Generic template affine registration produced landmark proposals. B-spline refinement first failed with an optimizer parameter-size error; a subsequent run ended with exit 143 and no proposal files were reported. The model then completed manual final checks and submitted normally.
image_count_note: Includes subject views and general reference/template images; not 72 unique subject scans.
